programme.desc: Elisha erhascht einen Blick auf Schwedens königliches Kriegsschiff, das nach 300 Jahren unter Wasser in einem mysteriös perfekten Zustand auferstanden ist.

programme.title: Boarding Pass
programme.desc: Emeline Nsingi Nkosi geht zum Polarkreis, wo sie den Weihnachtsmann in seinem Büro trifft. Sie versucht es auch mit Mitternachtssonnenschweben.

programme.title: Bucket List
programme.desc: Daniel Coll & Paddy Doherty entdecken verschiedene Möglichkeiten, Gyokuro-Tee, einen der hochwertigsten in Japan erhältlichen Tees, zu genießen, und besuchen seine Quelle.

programme.title: Backpack
programme.desc: Hannah Jackson erkundet die Landschaft, Kultur und Aromen auf den Inseln des Komodo-Nationalparks. Sie besucht auch den Tempel Taman Ayun auf Bali.

programme.title: Xplore Cambodia
programme.desc: Als Sukhmani die Tempel von Angkor besucht, stellt sie überrascht fest, dass diese nicht nur Schreine, sondern auch Statussymbole waren.

programme.title: Off The Grid
programme.sub-title: In Der Wildnis Nubra Valley, Indien
programme.desc: Im Nubra Valley nimmt Alex am lokalen Tanz teil und macht sich dann auf den Weg zu einem Ritt auf einem baktrischen Kamel über die Hunder-Sanddünen.

programme.title: City Breaks
programme.desc: Bikaner est connue de la plupart des gens comme la ville des collations salées de renommée mondiale. Cependant, lorsqu'Asmita s'y rend pour un voyage éclair, elle découvre qu'il y a beaucoup plus dans la ville rouge du Rajasthan qu'il n'y paraît. Des peintures miniatures que l'on peut trouver sur les murs des palais et des manoirs à travers la ville à l'architecture élaborée des anciennes havelis des marchands, elle découvre que Bikaner est un paradis pour les amateurs d'art

programme.title: Xplore Spain
programme.desc: Pour les fanatiques de football, la deuxième plus grande ville d'Espagne, Barcelone est le pays du sacré stade Camp Nou, qui abrite le club de football de renommée mondiale, le FC Barcelone. Pour les amateurs de plage, les plages de la ville offrent la sainte trinité du soleil, du sable et de la mer. Pour les gourmets, la capitale catalane est synonyme de fruits de mer frais, de jambon ibérique fin et de la tristement célèbre Sangria.

programme.title: Viajar Mexico
programme.desc: Le voyage de Charlie à travers le Mexique commence à La Paz, une évasion tranquille assise sur la mer de Cortez qui est souvent éclipsée par Cabo.

programme.title: Backpack
programme.desc: Heather commence son exploration serbe depuis la place de la République de Belgrade, en explorant les bâtiments. Plus loin, elle visite la forteresse de Kalemegdan en explorant les vestiges de l'époque romaine, hongroise et turque. Ensuite, elle visite le point de convergence des fleuves Danube et Sava, connu sous le nom de point Kissing. Le lendemain matin, concluant son séjour, elle visite le musée Nikola Tesla.

programme.title: City Breaks
programme.desc: Malgré une histoire remontant à l'époque romaine et des vestiges d'architecture médiévale et géorgienne, Manchester est davantage connue pour son passé industriel et son héritage musical et sportif presque sans égal. Célèbre mannequin et voyageuse, Sabrina Chakici découvre cela alors qu'elle explore le centre de la révolution industrielle, visite des musées et des magasins de disques vinyle et fait un trajet en train classique.

programme.title: Viajar Mexico
programme.desc: Cabo San Lucas est devenu l'une des destinations touristiques les plus prisées au monde, où les journées de sports nautiques se terminent par des soirées folles au coucher du soleil. Charlie, cependant, connaît et veut profiter d'un côté complètement différent de l'endroit : le côté rempli d'action. Avec de nombreux sports extrêmes proposés, Cabo peut rendre les visiteurs accros à la montée d'adrénaline. Mais quand Charlie aura l'occasion d'essayer l'une de ses activités les plus populaires.

programme.title: Backpack
programme.sub-title: Sac À Dos Novi Sad, Serbie
programme.desc: Heather dans cet épisode explore Novi Sad, une autre ville européenne située sur les rives du Danube. Elle commence sa journée en faisant du canoë sur le Danube et interagit plus tard avec un local, terminant sa journée en explorant la place de la Liberté et une église catholique romaine. Le lendemain, elle explore le marché local et découvre la brève histoire de la région en visitant une église orthodoxe et en terminant par une visite au bord de la plage du Danube.

programme.title: Xplore Spain
programme.desc: Barcelone était la toile de l'architecte de renommée mondiale, Antoni Gaudi, qui a marqué la ville avec ses créations fantastiques. Alex lui rend hommage à son chef-d'œuvre inachevé, Basílica de la Sagrada Família. Cette cathédrale extraordinaire se présente aujourd'hui comme le plus bel exemple du modernisme catalan, le projet architectural le plus ancien sur Terre, un grand hommage à Dieu et un témoignage du rêve dévorant d'un visionnaire excentrique.

programme.title: Xplore Spain
programme.desc: L'ambiance à Madrid, la capitale de l'Espagne, est aventureuse et sans prétention, mais avec un souci de qualité dans toutes les activités de la vie, de l'architecture et du design à la gastronomie et au vin. Alex découvre la scène artistique de Madrid et admire les images, les sons et les odeurs du très animé Mercado de San Miguel. Plus tard, elle s'offre un repas extravagant de cochon de lait dans le plus ancien restaurant en activité au monde.

programme.title: Viajar Mexico
programme.desc: Des lagons remplis de dauphins au charme colonial, Charlie présente les trésors de l'État le moins visité de la péninsule du Yucatan, Campeche.

programme.title: Backpack
programme.desc: Heather explore aujourd'hui Požarevac et visite une ville ancienne, Viminacium. mis en place par la septième légion de l'armée romaine. Elle visite ensuite un mausolée pour en apprendre davantage sur le passé glorieux de la ville. Explore plus tard le Musée national de Pozarevac et l'écurie de Ljubicevo. Son prochain arrêt est Majdanpek où elle explore les magnifiques grottes de Rajkova Pecina.

programme.title: Great World Hotels
programme.sub-title: Les Grands Hotels Du Monde The Residence
programme.desc: Il y a quelque chose de magique à être sur une petite île échouée au milieu de l'océan. Lors d'un voyage à l'île Maurice, Frieshia ressent la magie à travers le mélange unique de modernité et de tradition offert par le complexe de luxe The Residence. Du pays des merveilles marines aux bribes de la culture locale, tout ce qui concerne la nation insulaire a Freishia sous son charme.

programme.title: Costa Rica Calling
programme.desc: Dans la région de Manuel Antonio au Costa Rica, la quête de la faune sauvage de Geneviève la mène de la forêt tropicale à l’océan.

programme.title: Viajar Mexico
programme.desc: Entrez Charlie Rubio : un Mexicain de bonne foi, qui est là pour révéler toutes les choses merveilleuses qui font du Mexique son endroit préféré dans le monde.

programme.title: Xplore Spain
programme.desc: Alex trouve un morceau d'Afrique appelé Bioparc dans la troisième plus grande ville d'Espagne, Valence. Ce zoo de nouvelle génération l'impressionne avec son modèle innovant de « zoo-immersion », où les visiteurs sont amenés dans l'habitat des animaux, au lieu de l'inverse. Plus tard, elle se régale de la riche architecture gothique de La Lonja, l'ancien bâtiment de la bourse de la soie de la ville.

programme.title: Backpack
programme.desc: Après avoir exploré les grottes de Rajko, Heather poursuit son exploration de la Serbie en visitant le parc national de Djerdap, explorant le terrain et la beauté des paysages. En outre, elle essaie la cuisine serbe régionale et continue à explorer les ruines vieilles de 9000 ans des colonies danubiennes. De plus, elle visite la ville de Zajecar pour en savoir plus sur l'histoire romaine en Serbie. Sa prochaine destination est Nis où elle interagit avec un local et visite la tour Skull.

programme.title: Backpack
programme.desc: Heather dans cet épisode explore brièvement le côté historique de Mediana et se dirige vers un camp de concentration construit par les nazis pendant la Seconde Guerre mondiale. Ensuite, elle parapente au-dessus de la ville pour avoir une vue magnifique sur la ville. Plus tard, elle se rend dans un restaurant pour goûter à la cuisine locale et assister à un spectacle musical.

programme.title: Costa Rica Calling
programme.desc: Guidée par un irrésistible appel à l'aventure, la jeune voyageuse américaine Geneviève Sexton s'aventure au cœur du Costa Rica.

programme.title: Xplore Spain
programme.desc: Lors d'un voyage à Valence, Alex visite le plus grand aquarium marin d'Europe, L'Oceanogràfic, situé dans la « Cité des Arts et des Sciences ». Le complexe architectural avant-gardiste à l'extérieur l'émerveille presque autant que les représentations des principaux écosystèmes marins du monde à l'intérieur. En revanche, l'Espagne du vieux monde l'attire avec ses charmes classiques lorsqu'elle visite une arène de tauromachie traditionnelle et continue à apprendre les mouvements enflammés du flame...

programme.title: Viajar Mexico
programme.desc: Entrez Charlie Rubio : un Mexicain de bonne foi, qui est là pour révéler toutes les choses merveilleuses qui font du Mexique son endroit préféré dans le monde.

programme.title: Backpack
programme.desc: À Sjenica, Heather explore le canyon d'Uvac et repère le vautour fauve indigène. Plus tard, essaie la tarte préparée localement dans un restaurant et poursuit son exploration des grottes de Ledena. Le lendemain matin, alors qu'elle termine son voyage en sac à dos en Serbie, elle visite le parc national de Kopaonik, puis les vestiges d'une basilique chrétienne, se terminant aux cascades de Jelovarnik.

programme.title: Viajar Mexico
programme.desc: Entrez Charlie Rubio : un Mexicain de bonne foi, qui est là pour révéler toutes les choses merveilleuses qui font du Mexique son endroit préféré dans le monde.

programme.title: Xp Guide
programme.desc: Lors de la visite d'Elisha à Oslo, elle est émerveillée par les navires extraordinairement bien conçus utilisés par les légendaires Vikings de Norvège.

programme.title: World Spas
programme.sub-title: Spas De Classe Mondiale Evason Ma'in, Jordanie
programme.desc: Au Evason Ma'In Resort en Jordanie, Jamie essaie les soins du spa Srubis qui exploitent les propriétés curatives des sources chaudes voisines de Hammamat Ma'In.

programme.title: Viajar Mexico
programme.desc: Des plages accueillantes, des boutiques de premier ordre et une scène animée de bars et de restaurants font de Tulum le paradis bohème que les voyageurs du monde entier adorent aujourd'hui. C'est aussi, cependant, l'une des dernières villes qui a été construite et habitée par les Mayas. Charlie se régale des histoires mayas de cette région.

programme.title: Xp Guide
programme.desc: Avec une riche histoire remontant à plus de 1000 ans, les monuments emblématiques d'Oslo révèlent aux visiteurs son évolution à travers les âges.

programme.title: World Heritage
programme.desc: Chypre séduit sans effort les voyageurs par le charme d'un pays balnéaire méditerranéen ensoleillé. Lorsqu'ils en explorent davantage, cependant, ils trouvent les églises byzantines aux couleurs vives dans les chaînes de Troodos, qui révèlent les racines grecques de Chypre. Le rôle qu'il a joué dans l'évolution humaine se dévoile dans les trésors archéologiques de Khirokitia et de Paphos.

programme.title: Backpack
programme.sub-title: Sac À Dos Resavsk Pecina, Serbie
programme.desc: Heather commence sa journée en visitant et en explorant un monastère Manasija du XVe siècle à Despotovac. Plus tard, elle visite les grottes de Resavska, découvertes en 1962 et parle des formations naturelles. Le lendemain, elle est dans la ville de Zlatibor et profite des cascades de Gostilje. Plus loin, elle explore un village modèle et visite plus tard la maison et la station balnéaire du réalisateur de télévision serbe Emir Kusturica.

programme.title: Unbound
programme.desc: Sabrina besucht einen malerischen Laden, in dem Pralinen, rote Lebkuchenherzen und Honig hergestellt werden.

programme.title: Unbound
programme.desc: In Piran und Portoroz, zwei wunderschönen Städten an der slowenischen Riviera, schält Sabrina die Schichten des reichen Erbes des Landes ab.

programme.title: Unbound
programme.desc: „Ljubljeni“ bedeutet auf Slowenisch Geliebte. Sabrinas letzte Station auf ihrer Reise ist die Hauptstadt.

programme.title: Unbound
programme.desc: Vom Prätorianerpalast bis zum Tito-Platz bieten die berühmten Sehenswürdigkeiten von Koper Sabrina Einblicke in die Geschichte Sloweniens.

programme.title: Best From The Rest
programme.sub-title: Best From The Rest Oman Must Sees
programme.desc: A stunning contrast of deserts, mountains and beaches, its unspoilt landscape, dotted with grand forts, exquisite palaces, undulating dunes, canyons and lush wadis.

programme.title: Landmarks
programme.desc: Commissioned by William the Conqueror, York Castle in England has served as a center for regional governance, a royal mint, and a notorious prison.

programme.title: Food Fact Fun
programme.desc: Alex starts with Kangaroo meat pie in Whistler with a Australian ginger beer and continuing his food trail he visits Earls kitchen for a tuna dish. He then tries out e-biking and travels in the world’s highest cable car joining Blackcomb with Whistler mountain. Next, he visits Squamish lil’wat cultural center to learn about the Aboriginal people. Finally, he takes a tour of Pemberton valley on a horse, tries Canada’s highest zipline and bungee jumps over the Cheakamus river.

programme.title: Backpack
programme.desc: Sommer explores the bustling city of Ahmedabad and later visits the contrastingly tranquil, Sabarmati ashram, the home of Mahatma Gandhi.

programme.title: 10 Days Sri Lanka
programme.desc: Sabrina Bussandri visits the iconic sights of Colombo, and goes on to take a river safari and visit a turtle hatchery in Bentota.

programme.title: Xplore,Thailand
programme.desc: Speeding tuk-tuks, the revered Emerald Buddha and a grand fairytale in the heart of the city. Welcome to the capital city of Thailand - Bangkok.

programme.title: Burn Appetit
programme.desc: In Vienna, Jolly chances upon a Baroque palace that houses mysteries of not only the world in which we live but also of the heavens above.

programme.title: Xp Guide
programme.desc: Cesky Krumlov exhibits talent over the years. Its history is exhibited as an artist's vision through the paintings. The masquerade halls, massive courtyards the city lives up to its promises.

programme.title: Food Fact Fun
programme.desc: Alex Drobin experiences the North American energy and European charm of Montreal as he explores all that the city has to offer.

programme.title: Backpack
programme.desc: Follow our host,Sommer as she tries kayaking, scuba diving near a ship wreck,then interacts with a local to understand the history and culture of Goa.

programme.title: 10 Days Sri Lanka
programme.desc: Sabrina Bussandri loses herself in the colonial hangover of Galle. She also finds out about unique traditions such as mask making and stilt fishing.

programme.title: Xplore,Thailand
programme.desc: Shop at the popular khlongs, snuggle to little tiger cubs and watch ladyboys sashaying to the latest beats. Watch Xplore Thailand, featuring Bangkok.

programme.title: Burn Appetit
programme.desc: On the way to Graz from Vienna, Jolly makes an unexpected discovery: a medieval castle on a volcano, which is home to a dungeon of witches.

programme.title: Xp Guide
programme.desc: Oslo is the oldest of the Scandinavian capitals; with a rich history dating back to over 1000 years, the city’s iconic monuments reveal its evolution through the ages to visitors. programme.title: Live to Sea
programme.desc: A saga that follows Freddie Meadows on his tireless quest along the rugged edges of Sweden, in search of the region’s greatest waves; one of the final frontiers within surfing.

programme.title: Return of the Rhino
programme.desc: In 2021, after a thirty year absence, black rhino were reintroduced to the wilds of Gonarezhou National Park in Zimbabwe. This is a story about hope, truth and the claiming of a much needed foothold for the critically endangered black rhino species.

programme.title: SLAY
programme.desc: Follow investigative filmmaker Rebecca Cappelli as she travels around the world to uncover the dark side of the fashion industry.

programme.title: A Space in Time
programme.desc: Witness the extraordinary spirit of a family who choose to see their sons' challenges as superpowers, and celebrate the beauty of life, redefined.

programme.title: MILKED
programme.desc: This gripping investigation unmasks how the million-dollar cash-cow industry has been milked dry.

programme.title: Amber Tamm
programme.desc: Amber Tamm is a young woman from Brooklyn who is a horticulturist, floral designer, community advocate, and farmer.

programme.title: Dance for Change
programme.desc: An inspiring celebration of the Dance Crews of Dzaleka Refugee camp, who are transforming their community through creative expression.

programme.title: Lowest to Highest: One Foot in Front of the Other
programme.desc: A story of overcoming personal hurdles, resilience, connection, and how adversity can strengthen communities and individuals.

programme.title: Connected Off the Grid
programme.desc: Connected Off the Grid follows the stories of three unique off-grid lifestyles from the ocean, the desert, and the redwood forest to inspire us to stay connected to the earth and their communities.

programme.title: Against the Grain
programme.desc: The story of one of the most extensive permaculture experiments in the UK.

programme.title: Particle Physics
programme.desc: At only 21, Frank Wilczek, a graduate student at Princeton University, defined the properties of color gluons, which hold atomic nuclei together while working with David Gross. He is known, among other things, for the discovery of asymptotic freedom, the development of quantum chromodynamics, the invention of axions, and the discovery and exploitation of new forms of quantum statistics (anyons).

programme.title: Consciousness of Culture
programme.desc: Bruce Parry highlights the moments of his life that formed his career and life passion to champion indigenous cultures around the world through exploration and film. Bruce is interested in altered states of mind, and the creation of myths, why do we think what we think? And what life phenomena and environments sculpt these ideas?

programme.title: The Nature of All Things
programme.desc: What is it that makes things what they are? Where does it come from? For Professor Seyyed Hossein Nasr, the quest for knowledge, specifically knowledge which enables man to understand the true nature of things and which furthermore, liberates and delivers him from the fetters and limitations of earthly existence, has been (and continues to be) the central concern and determinant of how we understand and live our lives.

programme.title: Cosmopsychism
programme.desc: This episode of Curious Minds with Yujin Nagasawa discusses the unique idea of cosmopsychism; an idea which argues our personal conscious experiences are segments of a larger consciousness that belongs to the cosmos. Yujin Nagasawas life work lies in the mystery of consciousness, existence and the philosophy of religion. This controversial conversation with Deepak Chopra uncovers new theories and explanations for consciousness, as they strive to uncover truth.

programme.title: Consciousness & Healing
programme.desc: Dr. Shamini Jain conducts clinical research in the areas of psychoneuroimmunology and integrative medicine, receiving several awards from scientific organizations for her work. Shes been continuously interested in the process of healing and strived to uncover many of the doubts she had in undergraduate school when she discovered the field psychoneuroimmunology; the integrated relationship between mind, brain and body.

programme.title: Book Of Knowledge
programme.desc: Traveling the world 30+ years, David Verdesi finds himself back in Rome. Urged to uncover the reason behind the instinctive human desire for spiritual yearning, Verdesi starts retracing the intersection of science and theology within the city his family has called home since the early 1400s. Vibrating from the walls of the citys sacred spaces, he discovers findings of oral history, predating the beginning of humanity by thousands of years. Documents and rare rituals that upend conventional ideas of the behaviors of the mind in ancient times. Narratives heavily influenced by civilizations and cultures beyond Rome, continue to influence the moral compass of life today, Verdesi realizes he is back on the road. Book of Knowledge The Quest for Meaning rediscovers and preserves the knowledge of our human potential and natures wisdom. This movie addresses questions around the intersection of science, spirituality, and anthropology. Join David Verdesi to the roots of the Book of Knowledge.

programme.title: Particle Physics
programme.desc: At only 21, Frank Wilczek, a graduate student at Princeton University, defined the properties of color gluons, which hold atomic nuclei together while working with David Gross. He is known, among other things, for the discovery of asymptotic freedom, the development of quantum chromodynamics, the invention of axions, and the discovery and exploitation of new forms of quantum statistics (anyons).

programme.title: Consciousness of Culture
programme.desc: Bruce Parry highlights the moments of his life that formed his career and life passion to champion indigenous cultures around the world through exploration and film. Bruce is interested in altered states of mind, and the creation of myths, why do we think what we think? And what life phenomena and environments sculpt these ideas?

programme.title: The Nature of All Things
programme.desc: What is it that makes things what they are? Where does it come from? For Professor Seyyed Hossein Nasr, the quest for knowledge, specifically knowledge which enables man to understand the true nature of things and which furthermore, liberates and delivers him from the fetters and limitations of earthly existence, has been (and continues to be) the central concern and determinant of how we understand and live our lives.

programme.title: Astrology Zone
programme.desc: Susan Miller is the founder and astrologist for AstrologyZone.com. The trusted, twenty-year-old platform provides the latest in intelligent astrological trends. This discussion with Deepak Chopra breaks down many popular misconceptions about astrological predictions, the various disciplines of study, ego, and consciousness in relation to astrology. Miller also outlines the golden rule to understanding and getting the most out of astrological predications: astrology shows the condition, but not the outcomethat outcome is completely up to you. I can give you questions to ask to help you decide, but in the end, you write the script of your life.

programme.title: Modern Metaphysical Idealism
programme.desc: Dr. Bernardo Kastrup, philosopher and author has been leading the modern renaissance of metaphysical idealism. His theoretical reflections on the mind explain consciousness as the only element of life that allows us to understand reality, and everything we know about reality is subject to our experiences. This idea is often refuted by the thought that the brain is the source, not images and experiences provided by consciousness.

programme.title: Nature, Space and Matter
programme.desc: Our understanding of the nature of time, space and matter have changedeven what we mean by these termsin just the last few decades. Our interpretations continue to change and more theories form as we learn and study these topics. Dr. Fred Alan Wolf explains the origins of many of these foundational theories that have formed at different times and why they came about. Before quantum physics, people knew that human beings were conscious. We knew that animals were conscious. But now, with new revelations in quantum physics we begin to see a new role for consciousness.

programme.title: Creation Is Constant
programme.desc: Duane Elgin wants to show that the universe is a living field of existence, and that we are always in communion with a field of aliveness whether we are conscious of it or not. Throughout this lecture, Elgin explains his belief that in a living system, each part is integral to the whole, so each entity is intimately connected to the entire universe. To him, creation is not something that happened with the Big Bang. Instead, creation is consistently forming around us from a deeper abyss. The universes existence is brought moment by moment through this continuous, moving process.

programme.title: Consciousness & Healing
programme.desc: Dr. Shamini Jain conducts clinical research in the areas of psychoneuroimmunology and integrative medicine, receiving several awards from scientific organizations for her work. Shes been continuously interested in the process of healing and strived to uncover many of the doubts she had in undergraduate school when she discovered the field psychoneuroimmunology; the integrated relationship between mind, brain and body.

programme.title: Borderline Consciousness
programme.desc: Berit Brogaard was the first researcher to show that consciousness comes in degrees and that there can be borderline cases of consciousness. Her areas of research include perception, consciousness, emotions, philosophical psychology, semantics and philosophical logic. She also researches synesthesia, savant syndrome, blind sight, and perceptual reports.

programme.title: The Knobe Effect
programme.desc: We have experiences, creativity, understanding, thoughts, feelings and desires but do we know how these occurrences happen? Joshua Knobes research has been concerned with the impact of people's moral judgments on their intuitions about this question. He believes strongly that people's intuitions about whether a particular entity is conscious, essentially depends on whether the entity has the right sort of body. Therefore, he believes embodiment shapes our view of what is reality.

programme.title: Quantifying Beauty
programme.desc: How do we scientifically quantify beauty in people and in nature? How does the world embody beautiful ideas? Dr. Frank Wilczeks conversation with Deepak Chopra discusses his book, A Beautiful Question which tests the common misconceptions about how we form our opinions on success, beauty and our imaginations.

programme.title: Connections Between Science & Philosophy
programme.desc: Dr. Menas Kafatos is internationally known for bridging the disciplines, writing and lecturing extensively on the convergence between science and philosophy, as there is an inherent need for a dialogue between science, spirituality, and religion. His book, Creating Cosmos with Deepak Chopra discusses the melding of topics like inflation, environmental issues, natural hazards, quantum theory and consciousness.

programme.title: Iranian Space Pioneer
programme.desc: Iranian electrical engineer, entrepreneur and former astronaut, Anousheh Ansari was the first female private space explorer to fly to the International Space Station. She explains the challenging journey and the determination needed to reach space after immigrating to the U.S. from Iran. She also became the first person to publish a blog from space. The content invited readers to share her experience with the world. She described the Russian Soyuz capsule during liftoff, talked about the sights and smells of the space station, and explained the intricacies of everyday activities.

programme.title: Philosopher of the Mind
programme.desc: Dr. Paavo Pylkknens eclectic approach combines new physics-based insights with those of analytical philosophy, phenomenology, cognitive science and neuroscience. He proposes a view in which the mechanistic framework of classical physics and neuroscience is complemented by a more holistic approach. Pylkknen is particularly known for his work on mind-body-studies, building on David Bohm's interpretation of quantum mechanics.

programme.title: Evolution of Ideas
programme.desc: Everything we can know about our lives and the universe is a subjective experience, either formed by one's own perceptions or the reports of others. Dr. Bernardo Kastrup explains how we commonly associate this understanding about the universe as something separate of our consciousness, however he strongly believes otherwise; Kastrup believes the evolution of ideas we perceive about the universe are actually originating within us.

programme.title: Cosmopsychism

programme.title: Survive the Wild - S01:E01 - Rules of the Realm
programme.desc: Tiere oder Gruppen schützen ihr Territorium, indem sie Geräusche wie singende Vögel oder Düfte wie Pheromone von vielen Säugetieren verwenden, um Grenzen zu markieren. Dies sind nur die ersten Warnungen. Wenn andere Tiere diese Zeichen ignorieren, kann es zu Konflikten kommen. Tiere benötigen ein sicheres Territorium, um sich fortzupflanzen, ihre Jungen großzuziehen und sicherzustellen, dass genügend Nahrung und Ressourcen für das Überleben vorhanden sind. Diese Episode betrachtet die Strategien, die Tiere verwenden, um ihr Territorium zu beanspruchen.

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E42 - Diana A Model Princess
programme.desc: Dianas Modebewusstsein wurde oft genau beobachtet. Sie hatte ein Talent dafür, Outfits auszuwählen, die sowohl stilvoll als auch anspruchsvoll waren und stets Aufmerksamkeit erregten. Ihre Hüte waren ein weiteres herausragendes Merkmal; oft trug sie elegante Designs, die ihrem Look eine zusätzliche Anmut verliehen. Auch ihre Frisur war ikonisch, meist ordentlich gestylt mit einem leichten Schwung, der ihr Gesicht perfekt umrahmte und zu ihrem eleganten Auftritt beitrug.

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E45 - Charles A Portrait A Man Alone
programme.desc: Dies erzählt die Geschichte eines Mannes, der den Stress seiner öffentlichen Verpflichtungen mit den Herausforderungen einer scheiternden Ehe, die sich vor den Augen der Welt abspielt, jongliert. Es ist ein besonderer Blick auf den Mann, der zum König bestimmt ist.

programme.title: Man Eats Wild - S02:E07 - Hawaii Access Shane Dorian
programme.desc: Die Zahl der Achsenhirsche in Hawaii ist explodiert und stellt ein großes Problem für dieses atemberaubende Pazifikparadies dar. In dieser Episode trifft Mario auf Shane Dorian, einen Big-Wave-Surfer, während sie sich auf eine Expedition begeben.

programme.title: Man Eats Wild - S02:E08 - Talking Turkey Frank Stallone
programme.desc: Mario tut sich mit Frank Stallone zusammen und reist nach Kansas, um Easton-Truthähne zu finden. Mit Franks italienischen Wurzeln ist Mario sicher, dass sie unglaubliche Putenfleischbällchen kreieren können.

programme.title: Wardens - S06:E18 - Fly By
programme.desc: Wächter errichten in Region 5, Montana, USA, eine Kontrollstation. Als die Jäger beschließen, sie zu umgehen, beginnt die Verfolgung.

programme.title: Wardens - S06:E19 - Road Warrior
programme.desc: Aufseher stellen eine Attrappe auf, um Straßenjagd in Region 7 in Montana, USA, zu stoppen. Es dauert nicht lange, bis sie einen Schützen erwischen.

programme.title: The New Frontier - S02:E01 - Astronauts
programme.desc: Einhundert Kilometer über der Erdoberfläche liegt eine unsichtbare Grenze: der Rand des Weltraums. Das ist die Karman-Linie, die Grenze zwischen der Atmosphäre unseres Planeten und dem, was dahinter liegt. Was braucht es, um diese Linie zu überschreiten?

programme.title: The New Frontier - S02:E02 - Getting UpThere
programme.desc: Der Start von Nutzlasten in den Weltraum ist eine sehr schwierige Aufgabe. In der Vergangenheit waren Raketenstarts die sprichwörtlichen "Schwerter zu Pflugscharen" Raketen, die für den Transport von Atomsprengköpfen entwickelt wurden, schicken heute Satelliten und Sonden ins Sonnensystem. Ironischerweise ist das eine der wenigen Leistungen der Menschheit, die es in der Natur nicht gibt.

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons - S01:E07 - Scoreless
programme.desc: Mit einer einzigartigen Methode knackt Nick Wells (Robert De Niro) einen Safe, indem er einen Brennschneider verwendet, um durch den Safe zu schneiden, ihn mit Wasser zu füllen und die Tür mit einem kleinen Sprenggerät zu sprengen. Wir testen dies sowie die Auswirkungen eines 20-mm-Panzergewehrs auf einen Safe aus dem Film Thunderbolt and Lightfoot.

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons - S01:E08 - Terry Vs Gorn
programme.desc: Terry und Larry testen Star Trek am Set der Star Trek Original Series in Upstate NY. Terry und Larry finden sich an Bord der USS Enterprise wieder und testen die Theorie, dass Kirk eine Kanone aus einem Bambusrohr, Magnesiumpulver und Steinmessern sowie Fellen hergestellt haben könnte. Es hat bei Star Trek funktioniert, aber würde es wirklich funktionieren?

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E12 - The New Royals
programme.desc: Prinzessinnen Beatrice und Eugenie haben in ihrem Leben viel Medienaufmerksamkeit und schwierige Situationen durchgemacht. Von der sehr öffentlichen Trennung ihrer Eltern bis hin zur Zielscheibe der Presse waren sie schon einiges durchgemacht. Trotz alldem bleiben sie demmonarchieverpflichtetund engagieren sich in ihrer gemeinnützigen Arbeit.

programme.desc: Terry und Larry testen Star Trek am Set der Star Trek Original Series in Upstate NY. Terry und Larry finden sich an Bord der USS Enterprise wieder und testen die Theorie, dass Kirk eine Kanone aus einem Bambusrohr, Magnesiumpulver und Steinmessern sowie Fellen hergestellt haben könnte. Es hat bei Star Trek funktioniert, aber würde es wirklich funktionieren?

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E12 - The New Royals
programme.desc: Prinzessinnen Beatrice und Eugenie haben in ihrem Leben viel Medienaufmerksamkeit und schwierige Situationen durchgemacht. Von der sehr öffentlichen Trennung ihrer Eltern bis hin zur Zielscheibe der Presse waren sie schon einiges durchgemacht. Trotz alldem bleiben sie demmonarchieverpflichtetund engagieren sich in ihrer gemeinnützigen Arbeit.

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E42 - Diana A Model Princess
programme.desc: Dianas Modebewusstsein wurde oft genau beobachtet. Sie hatte ein Talent dafür, Outfits auszuwählen, die sowohl stilvoll als auch anspruchsvoll waren und stets Aufmerksamkeit erregten. Ihre Hüte waren ein weiteres herausragendes Merkmal; oft trug sie elegante Designs, die ihrem Look eine zusätzliche Anmut verliehen. Auch ihre Frisur war ikonisch, meist ordentlich gestylt mit einem leichten Schwung, der ihr Gesicht perfekt umrahmte und zu ihrem eleganten Auftritt beitrug.

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E45 - Charles A Portrait A Man Alone
programme.desc: Dies erzählt die Geschichte eines Mannes, der den Stress seiner öffentlichen Verpflichtungen mit den Herausforderungen einer scheiternden Ehe, die sich vor den Augen der Welt abspielt, jongliert. Es ist ein besonderer Blick auf den Mann, der zum König bestimmt ist.

programme.title: Man Eats Wild - S02:E07 - Hawaii Access Shane Dorian
programme.desc: Die Zahl der Achsenhirsche in Hawaii ist explodiert und stellt ein großes Problem für dieses atemberaubende Pazifikparadies dar. In dieser Episode trifft Mario auf Shane Dorian, einen Big-Wave-Surfer, während sie sich auf eine Expedition begeben.

programme.title: Man Eats Wild - S02:E08 - Talking Turkey Frank Stallone
programme.desc: Mario tut sich mit Frank Stallone zusammen und reist nach Kansas, um Easton-Truthähne zu finden. Mit Franks italienischen Wurzeln ist Mario sicher, dass sie unglaubliche Putenfleischbällchen kreieren können.

programme.title: Wardens - S06:E18 - Fly By
programme.desc: Wächter errichten in Region 5, Montana, USA, eine Kontrollstation. Als die Jäger beschließen, sie zu umgehen, beginnt die Verfolgung.

programme.title: Wardens - S06:E19 - Road Warrior
programme.desc: Aufseher stellen eine Attrappe auf, um Straßenjagd in Region 7 in Montana, USA, zu stoppen. Es dauert nicht lange, bis sie einen Schützen erwischen.

programme.title: The New Frontier - S02:E01 - Astronauts
programme.desc: Einhundert Kilometer über der Erdoberfläche liegt eine unsichtbare Grenze: der Rand des Weltraums. Das ist die Karman-Linie, die Grenze zwischen der Atmosphäre unseres Planeten und dem, was dahinter liegt. Was braucht es, um diese Linie zu überschreiten?

programme.title: The New Frontier - S02:E02 - Getting UpThere
programme.desc: Der Start von Nutzlasten in den Weltraum ist eine sehr schwierige Aufgabe. In der Vergangenheit waren Raketenstarts die sprichwörtlichen "Schwerter zu Pflugscharen" Raketen, die für den Transport von Atomsprengköpfen entwickelt wurden, schicken heute Satelliten und Sonden ins Sonnensystem. Ironischerweise ist das eine der wenigen Leistungen der Menschheit, die es in der Natur nicht gibt.

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons - S01:E07 - Scoreless
programme.desc: Mit einer einzigartigen Methode knackt Nick Wells (Robert De Niro) einen Safe, indem er einen Brennschneider verwendet, um durch den Safe zu schneiden, ihn mit Wasser zu füllen und die Tür mit einem kleinen Sprenggerät zu sprengen. programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: Yusho's advanced Dueltaining manages to push Yuri into a corner and bring Yuya back to his old self. But Yuri is determined to complete Zarc's revival and has one nasty surprise in store for Yusho.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: Seeing his father carded in front of his eyes, Yuya's rage reaches a boiling point as he accepts Yuri's challenge. But not only does he have to contend with Yugo and Yuri's dragons, but Zarc's ever growing influence over him.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: The four dimensions start to fuse together as Yuya continues to struggle against Yuri. Forced to discard his trump card, things seem hopeless. Yuya's friends then arrive to encourage him to keep fighting no matter what.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: Yuya absorbs all of his counterparts and reclaimed his true form as Supreme King Z-ARC. Starting to lay waste to the Fusion Dimension, Sora and Edo challenge Zarc to try and reach out to Yuya's spirit.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: The four dimensions continue to unite as Zarc effortlessly crushes Sora and Edo. Kaito and Shun continue the fight against Zarc while people from Heartland and Neo Domino City start appearing in the Fusion Dimension.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: Gongenzaka and Jack fight against Zarc next, trying their best to reach out to Yuya's soul buried in Zarc's darkness. A revived Crow and Sawatari decide to join in when Zarc's Supreme King Dragons swarm the field.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: Crow notices that Zarc is starting to lose his composure, leading him and Sawatari to up their game against Zarc's dragons. As dimensional integration is getting closer to completion, Reiji tries to convince his dad to stop Zarc.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: Ray's soul possesses Reira so she can battle against Zarc alongside Reiji. Zarc boasts that he is the creator of Pendulum Summon, but Ray is determined to stop him once and for all using the four natural energy cards.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: Things have seemingly returned to normal in the Pendulum Dimension, but Yuya gets the feeling that something is missing. Reiji has him duel against Tsukikage to restore his memories and make him finish the Lancer's goal for good.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: The battle royale continues. As Yuya keeps fighting, his memories start flooding back to him. Yuzu's dad suddenly remembers too as the rest of the world slowly begins to remember the Lancers and the battle against Zarc.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: Reiji reveals that Zarc is still alive and Reira is barely holding back his malevolence. The world must be united and Yuya must purge Zarc's evil once and for all. Yuya is unsure. but Gongenzaka attempts to ignite his fighting spirit.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: Yuya arrives in the Xyz Dimensions with Dennis as his next opponent. Threatening to turn the traumatized citizens of Heartland into cards again, Dennis forces Yuya into a duel against him and his Xyz/Fusion mix.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: Yuya arrives in the Fusion Dimension where he finds a distraught Shun. Like with Yuya's counterparts, Ruri and the others have not been resurrected following Ray's revival. Yuya tries to calm Shun down only to end up the target of his fury.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: Jack appears to taunt Yuya over his fear of using his counterpart's dragons in fear of summoning Zarc. Unable to accomplish anything as is, Yuya challenges Jack to a duel while Reiji makes it so everyone can watch the battle.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: Yuya finally listens to his other selves and summons all four of his dragons to defeat Jack. However, there is one final challenge before him in order to become a Dueltainer and purge Zarc: his rival and friend Reiji Akaba.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: The curtain is about to fall for the last time. The final battle between Yuya and Reiji rages on. Dragons face off against D/D/D as the whole world watches. What will be the final fate of Yuya, Yuzu, and all four dueling dimensions?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: In Heartland, Yuma Tsukumo aspires to be the world's best Duelist. Despite this, he is not a good Duelist. When he ends up Dueling, Shark, a student known to have pro-level skills, odd things begin to happen and Yuma's story begins.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: The Duel between Yuma and Ryoga comes to its conclusion. In order to take down "Leviathan Dragon", Yuma obtains a "Number" monster of his own, "Utopia".

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: Astral's been unable to leave since Yuma Dueled Shark, so, despite his reluctance, he's begun living with Yuma. At an inconvenient time, Akari Tsukumo has trouble when her PC she uses as a stay-at-home reporter crashes. When her big scoop is deleted as a result of a system down the city suffered, she orders Yuma to find an alternate scoop she can use for another manuscript. When Yuma goes into town, the traffic lights go nuts, causing downtown to fall into chaos. Yuma looks for the criminal who spread the computer virus that caused all this chaos.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: Yuma challenges Professor Kitano, who is behind it all. Professor Kitano notes that each time he reduces his opponent's Life Points with "Electronic Computer-Beast Tera Byte" Astral's body weakens, causing him to slowly vanish! To make things worse, the Explosive Virus Time Bomb Ukyo has set is slowly reaching its countdown.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: A strange shadow approaches Yuma, which turns out to be Tokunosuke Omoteura, a classmate of Yuma's known for his duplicitous tongue. In the morning, Yuma was reprimanded for a prank he pulled in front of the whole class that he has no memory of causing. As a result, he's been cut off from every one else. Tokunosuke gently says "Let's Duel". With "Baby Tragon" his new Xyz Monster, Yuma might enjoy this duel, but Tokunosuke seems to be planning something.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: Tokunosuke steals Yuma's "Utopia", causing Astral to vanish. Tokunosuke wanted the great power of Numbers, and Yuma tries to Summon "Leviathan Dragon" to fight back, but Tokunosuke's Trap Card takes even that away. When Yuma is pushed into a corner with his field, an unexpected monster will become the Trump Card of the Duel.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: After having been around a while and having to work with Yuma, Astral's been fascinated by a TV Show Hero named "Different Dimension ESPer Robin". For some reason, Astral feels close and similar to this Robin from an alternate universe. One day, pictures show up with Robin in a fight downtown! Yuma, prodded by Astral, goes with Kotori to where the autographs were taken and meets Robin's actor, a kid named Fuya! But Fuya is a timid boy who doesn't resemble the Robin they all admire in the slightest.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: The mysterious person posing as Robin around town was Fuya. Under the intolerable strain of being a hero, Fuya's heart has been overcome by darkness Yuma challenges him to a Duel to save his soul. Robin, however, possesses "Number 83: Galaxy Queen". With it, he proceeds to summon one character after another from the TV Show. At first, Yuma and Astral were amused by this, but due to Galaxy Queen's almighty Monster Effect, they quickly grow impatient. To make things worse, Galaxy Queen, who currently possesses Robin, has taken on the appearance of Fuya's mother.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: A suspicious shadow is trailing Yuma. It seems someone has been after Yuma, and their identity is the unassuming girl Cat-chan from Yuma's class. Yuma and Kotori fall into Cat-chan's trap. To rescue Kotori, he's going to have to Duel. Astral is cautious of the strange vibes he's getting from Cat-chan, especially with the strategy of her "Transforming Cat Deck"!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: Yuma is reminded that his victories in his current Duels are due to Astral's help. To prove his skills, he fights Shark once more. Though Shark doesn't care to Duel again, he finally agrees when he finally reaches the end of his rope due to Yuma's constant following him around. The Duel of these two begins. Can Yuma win against Shark, who has no "Number" cards, when he himself declares he won't use his "Number" cards or take the aid of Astral!?After his Duel with Shark, Yuma Duels Tetsuo Takeda without "Numbers" and loses twenty times in a row, with Tetsuo angry because Yuma lied about not using the "Numbers" against Shark. Yuma is scolded by Astral on his immaturity. On the other hand, Shark returns to "his place" where he gets involved in criminal company. Yuma, who knew what was going on with Shark, challenges the two strongest thugs: Rikuo and Kaio, to what Shark proposes to be a 2 on 2 "Tag-Team Duel".

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: After his Duel with Shark, Yuma Duels Tetsuo Takeda without "Numbers" and loses twenty times in a row, with Tetsuo angry because Yuma lied about not using the "Numbers" against Shark. Yuma is scolded by Astral on his immaturity. On the other hand, Shark returns to "his place" where he gets involved with a criminal network. Yuma, who knew what was going on with Shark, challenges the two strongest thugs: Rikuo and Kaio, to what Shark proposes to be a 2 on 2 "Tag-Team Duel".

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: Yuma finds himself pinned down by the overwhelming power of "Number 61: Volcasaurus". To protect their precious remaining Life Points, he defends Shark at his own expense. When their opponents summon their second Number monster at that point, Astral becomes aware of the hidden mysteries underlying the Duel. In a last-ditch effort, Shark notices Yuma's passion and entrusts him with 1 card that could turn the whole Duel around!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: After a series of incidents, Yuma and Astral learn of the existence of a "Number Hunter". Astral remains wary of an unseen presence, but Yuma pretends not to care. As a result, a series of strange phenomena appear around these two. Undeniably, these are the signs of the coming of the "Number Hunter" named Kaito Tenjo. At that moment, a dangerous Duel with the Numbers cards on the line begins. With Kaito's power far beyond their reckoning, what can Astral or Yuma possibly do?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: In just 1 Turn, Kaito Summons 2 Numbers. Yuma attempts to resist the onslaught, but all of his monsters have been removed from the field...! Kaito, capable of even more, summons the strongest Monster to exist: "Galaxy-Eyes Photon Dragon", which has never been seen before! Yuma summons "Number 39: Utopia" to create a turnaround despite the impossible odds facing him.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: Having clearly seen Kaito's power, and how utterly hopeless they are, Yuma and Astral are keenly aware that they cannot easily recover. At that time, Yuma talks to his grandmother. She mentions a mysterious old man named Jurou at a "Duel Lodge" who owns a wooden statue of the Legendary Monster "Dark Magician", who is waiting for Yuma and his crew. Yuma makes a strong wish based on his desire to train and get better!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: It's a Duel against Jurou's former disciple, Yamikawa! Yamikawa draws his Ninja monsters, pinning Yuma down, but believing in the power of his friends, Yuma must continue this battle to the Death! But, Yamikawa summons his Trump Card, the Number Monster "Armed Ninja - Crimson Shadow"! However, Yuma continues to believe in the power of his friends, but can this possibly lead him to win the Duel!?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: Kotori and her friends, who are interested in the Number cards, plus Astral, form the "Number Club". To get more info about the Numbers, they visit the home of a fortuneteller, but the fortuneteller is under the orders of Kaito to collect the Number Cards! When the fortuneteller, Jin, kidnaps Kotori and the rest, Yuma and Astral come to the rescue, but the memory of their Duel with Kaito comes back, the visions of which continue to haunt them!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: To save Kotori and the rest, Yuma continues to fight with Jin over the Numbers. Yuma's Life Points continue to fall, putting the fate of Kotori and the rest in a perilous situation, as Jin worsens things by summoning a second Numbers. In the midst of such a terrible pinch, Astral finds himself scared by Kaito's looming shadow, but when he sees Yuma who refuses to give up, he steps back up to the fight. With the feelings of these two guys, "Utopia" obtains a new power!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: Yuma misplaces the the Emperor's Key that was an important momento from his parents. He and Astral look high and low for it, but they just can't seem to find it. While they look, Astral is curious as to how the Emperor's Key is related to Yuma's father. Yuma starts talking about various memories from his childhood that he remembers about his dad. Yuma's Never-Give-Up Spirit "Kattobingu" was born from a promise he made with his father.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: Yuma safely recovers "Number 96: Black Mist" from a man. Tetsuo, who witnessed the Duel, takes note that Yuma seems suddenly more brutal in his strategy, and ends up in a fight with him. Not having reconciled in over 2 days, suddenly Number 96 swallows Yuma and Astral up!! To rescue Yuma and Astral from Number 96, Tetsuo fights the Numbers for the first time!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: As they head home from class, Yuma and his friends meet Lilly who becomes their friend. However, after the robot is reprogrammed to its former self, Yuma duels Lilly in order to help regain her memories.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: In order to protect Yuma's Key from Kite, Shark faces him in a Duel.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: While Yuma seeks for his Key, Astral duels against Kite to defend the Number cards he possesses.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: Despite being unable to fight against the immense power of Galaxy-Eyes Photon Dragon, Astral, his resolve stern due to Feeling the Flow, continues a desperate combo of Offense and Defense. But when he finally gives up against Kite who keeps attacking him over and over, Yuma appears and the mysterious ZEXAL power activates...

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: One morning, Yuma heads to school, and while talking to his friends, time stops. He sees three suns shining in the sky. Together with Astral, they both shiver from a fear they do not understand, causing Yuma to run off to find out what possibly could have happened. At that time, Kite, using Dr. Faker's technology, retraces Astral's memories and invites Yuma to the World Duel Carnival.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: The World Duel Carnival, where Duelists from around the world will wage heated battles, is swiftly approaching. Yuma, seeking to fulfill his dream of becoming "Duel Champion", excitedly rushes to the tournament. But what will Yuma do when he has no Heart Pieces, which serve as the proof of participation for the WDC? Meanwhile, Mr. Heartland and Kite make their preparations to gather the Numbers that are likely to assemble before them in this tournament.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: Yuma's first opponent in the World Duel Carnival is the soccer kid, Striker. Striker transforms the surrounding stadium with his Field Spell Card, as the Duel kicks off. With his "Offside Trap", Striker brilliantly seals Yuma's strategies, while his teammate monsters use teamwork to frantically keep beating Yuma up with a combo of offense and defense and with such sheer strength, it seems as if Striker's victory is decided...

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: While looking for an opponent to Duel, Yuma meets a boy named Cody, who loves construction equipment, at a construction site. Yuma, interested in the construction equipment Deck Cody uses, challenges him to a Duel. However, Cody Xyz Summons his "Digvorzhak, King of Heavy Industry".

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: Anna Kaboom attempts to kill Yuma with a cannon. He negotiates with her and they Duel instead so that Anna can try to take her revenge. Their past history is not what it initially seems.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: Tombo Tillbitty Duels people, defeating them with his "Basket Rule" and takes their Heart Pieces. Dextra and Nistro appear near one of the defeated Duelists. They see he has vegetables stuffed in his mouth, and Dextra sees blood on his shirt. Dextra inspects closer, and licks it up, telling the disgusted Nistro it's just tomato juice.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: Charlie McCay steals "Number 7: Lucky Straight" from a gallery. Kari, who has past history with Charlie, sends Yuma after him. He and Astral witness the power of the "Lucky Straight" when Charlie performs a One Turn Kill on a World Duel Carnival competitor. Charlie makes his escape, stealing more cards in the process, including one of Yuma's "Numbers".

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: Charlie McCay escapes on the single-track railroad and Yuma starts the Duel. But Charlie's "Number 7: Lucky Straight" possesses amazing luck. If he hits the jackpot by rolling the dice, then Charlie's Life Points will become 100,000. On the verge of giving up when all of his attempts to stop that strong luck become fruitless, Yuma discovers an unexpected strategy.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: The second day of WDC starts. More energetic than ever, Bronk and Caswell decide to battle the Asian Duel Champion, Quattro. According to these two, the gentleman Quattro has a respectable Duel aesthetic, which is also admired by many Duelists from their hearts. Witnessed by Yuma, Astral, Tori and Trey, the Battle Royal between Quattro, Bronk, and Caswell starts, but Quattro soon reveals his true side which remained hidden until now.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: Shark is determined to have his revenge on Quattro, but Quattro's younger brother Trey snares Shark with a Duel Anchor and allows Quattro to leave. Trey's mission from Vetrix and Quinton is to give a "Number" to Shark, which he accomplishes. Shark is able to resist completely being controlled by the "Number" and defeats Trey.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: After Yuma laments over Shark dueling in revenge against Quattro, he's irritated by everything that's going on and ends up getting into a squabble with Tori. Meanwhile, elsewhere in the tournament, a photographer named Cameron has won Duel after Duel against Duelists with the help of terrifying ability of his that leaves them in terror. Cameron's superpower is apparently a gift to be able to take photographs of the future. With Cameron's "Future Photographs", his opponent's entire strategy is laid bare before him, allowing him to relentlessly defeat Duelists.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: Yuma is having trouble in his Duel against Cameron, and the dangerous future of Tori encountering an accident is continuously approaching. Then, "Number 25: Force Focus", controlled by Cameron, finally shows up. Yuma cannot win without Summoning "Utopia", but according to the prophecy, Yuma will lose in this Duel for sure if he Summons it. Under this desperate circumstance, in order to grasp the future within his own hands, Yuma delivers a bold strategy!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: In order to prevent Flip from being disqualified from the WDC, Yuma Duels against Dextra and Nistro. Meanwhile, Astral faces against an old enemy inside Emperor's Key.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: The Duel between Yuma against Dextra and Nistro continues. Due to their combination, Yuma is pushed into a corner, even after Summoning "Utopia" thanks to Astral. However due to the bonds between the two, a reversal occurs!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: Yuma's Heart Pieces are stolen by Pip, and Cathy Duels to get them back.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: Yugi contra Pegasus, el partido del milenio: Parte 2
programme.desc: Pegasus usa la baraja de Dibujos Animados y la capacidad de leer la mente que usó con Kaiba y pone a los monstruos de Yugi en su contra. Yugi pierde la voluntad de luchar. ¿Encerrará Pegaso el alma de Yugi en una carta como hizo con Kaiba?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: Yugi contra Pegasus, el partido del milenio: Parte 3
programme.desc: Yugi ha averiguado cómo contrarrestar la capacidad de leer la mente de Pegasus: Yugi se mueve entre sus dos almas y es capaz de destruir el Mundo Dibujos Animados de Pegasus, pero aún no ha empezado el mortal Juego de las Sombras.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: Yugi contra Pegasus, el partido del milenio: Parte 4
programme.desc: Yugi se desploma agotado bajo el poder paralizante del Juego de Sombras. Sus amigos le gritan desesperados ánimos, pero sus voces no penetran en la esfera de oscuridad. La oportunidad de victoria de Yugi se está esfumando, al igual que su vida.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: Yugi contra Pegasus, el partido del milenio: Parte 5
programme.desc: Pegasus invoca a Perdido, un temible monstruo que consume los Monstruos de Duelo de Yugi. Yugi contraataca con... ¿Kuriboh? ¿La criatura más pequeña y débil del juego? ¿Se ha rendido Yugi o se trata de una última estrategia para obtener la victoria?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: La Saga de Pegaso llega a su fin, ¡pero un nuevo viaje está a punto de comenzar! Yugi se encuentra con un misterioso egipcio llamado Shadi que entra en la mente de Yugi con la Llave del Milenio.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi y sus amigos regresan del Reino de los Duelistas y se encuentran con una joven llamada Rebecca que exige que el abuelo le devuelva el Dragón Blanco de Ojos Azules. Ha venido a recuperar la carta que el abuelo le robó hace muchos años.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Rebecca cree por equivocación que el abuelo le robó el Dragón Blanco de Ojos Azules. Yugi debe defender al Dragón Blanco de Ojos Azules para enseñarle que lo que cuenta no es el poder de las cartas, sino el corazón que hay en ellas.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Con sus engaños, el Consejo de Administración de KaibaCorp atrapa a Kaiba dentro de un juego de realidad virtual. Mokuba recluta a Yugi y Joey para liberar a Kaiba de este juego definitivo en el que perder equivale a morir.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: La búsqueda de Kaiba continúa con un poco de ayuda de... ¿Mai? Pero, ¿podrán Yugi y sus amigos adaptarse a un mundo virtual en el que las reglas y las estrategias cambian a cada paso?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi y sus amigos rescatan a Kaiba, ¡pero siguen atrapados en el juego! La única salida es superar al Dragón de Cinco Cabezas, pero en el difícil duelo, ¡Joey, Mokuba y Mai pierden todos sus puntos de vida!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: Monstruos de la mazmorra de los dados: Parte 1
programme.desc: Un nuevo estudiante, Duke Devlin, derrota a Joey en una partida de Duelo de Monstruos, obligando a Joey a convertirse en su sirviente. Duke obliga a Joey a ponerse un disfraz de perro y lo humilla en público, obligando a Yugi a retar a Duke a un duelo.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: Monstruos de la mazmorra de los dados: Parte 2
programme.desc: A cambio de la libertad de Joey, Yugi se juega renunciar a los Duelos de Monstruos para siempre. Yugi tiene un comienzo difícil. Todo empeora cuando Duke revela que ha diseñado los Dados Monstruos de la Mazmorra con la ayuda de Pegasus.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: Monstruos de la mazmorra de los dados: Parte 3
programme.desc: Yugi utiliza sus habilidades innatas para el juego para dar la vuelta a la tortilla, pero Duke tiene una regla más que mencionar: Todas las criaturas ocupan territorio en el tablero cuadriculado.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: Monstruos de la mazmorra de los dados: Parte 4
programme.desc: Después de que el todopoderoso Orgoth el Despiadado de Duke haga trizas a todo el plantel de monstruos de Yugi, a Yugi solo le queda un turno antes de perder todos sus puntos de corazón.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Un adivino misterioso roba el Rompecabezas del Milenio, y Yugi debe derrotarlo en un duelo para recuperarlo. Sin embargo, no se trata de un adivino cualquiera; es un conocido y formidable enemigo del Reino de los Duelistas... ¿o no?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: La misteriosa amenaza que controla a Bandido Keith rompe el Rompecabezas del Milenio en pedazos antes de incendiar la arena de duelos. ¿Podrá Yugi recomponer el Rompecabezas del Milenio y salvar al espíritu antes de que las llaman envuelvan toda la sala?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: ¡Se revela el origen de Duelo de Monstruos! Utilizando la magia del Collar del Milenio, la historiadora egipcia Ishizu Ishtar muestra a Kaiba cómo se jugaba al Duelo de Monstruos hace milenios.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: El espíritu del Rompecabezas del Milenio ve que han desaparecido sus recuerdos del antiguo Egipto, pero Téa le ayudará a descubrir los misterios de su pasado. El duelista Johnny Steps y sus monstruos musicales del rock interrumpirán su búsqueda.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Para afrontar el futuro, Yugi debe mirar el pasado. Yugi fue un poderoso faraón que salvó al mundo hace cinco milenios. Kaiba pone a prueba los poderes ocultos de su carta egipcia Obelisco el Atormentador contra la furia del Dragón Máximo de Ojos Azules.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: Acechado por los Cazadores de Rarezas
programme.desc: Un grupo de siniestros Cazadores de Rarezas acorralan a Joey y le obligan a batirse en duelo. Si Joey pierde, los Cazadores de Rarezas se quedan con su Dragón B. de Ojos Rojos. Joey aplasta a sus enemigos, pero hay otros caminos a la victoria.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: Yugi contra el Cazador de Rarezas, Parte 1: Comienza la ciudad de las batallas
programme.desc: Es hora de aprender nuevas reglas y monstruos. ¡Que comience el Torneo de la Ciudad de la Batalla! En el primer duelo del torneo, Yugi desafía al Cazador de Rarezas para recuperar el Dragón B. de Ojos Rojos de Joey.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: Yugi contra el Cazador de Rarezas, Parte 2: Contra Exodia
programme.desc: Yugi descubre la estrategia del Cazador de Rarezas para invocar al todopoderoso Exodia, ¡pero es demasiado tarde para detenerlo! El Cazador de Rarezas ya tiene cuatro piezas de Exodia en su mano, y la quinta y última pieza está encima de su mazo.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: El duelista psíquico Espa Roba derrota a Rex Raptor muy fácilmente, ¡y Joey es el siguiente en su lista de objetivos! ¿Qué posibilidades tiene Joey cuando Espa Roba tiene la capacidad telepática de leer todas las cartas del mazo de Joey?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Joey descubre que la percepción extrasensorial de Espa Roba es un engaño, ¡pero no se ha librado de sus manipulaciones! El Jinzo de Espa Roba mata a todos los monstruos de Joey y aumenta su poder en cada turno. ¿Ha llegado a su fin la suerte de Joey?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: El Maestro de los Magos: Parte 1
programme.desc: Arkana, el mago duelista, transporta a Yugi a la arena de duelo más letal del mundo, donde el perdedor es enviado al Reino de las Sombras. Yugi debe ganar este duelo o perderá mucho más que a su Mago Oscuro.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: El Maestro de los Magos: Parte 2
programme.desc: ¡Es Mago Oscuro contra Mago Oscuro! Sin embargo, mientras Yugi solo controla un Mago Oscuro, Arkana tiene tres en su mazo. Aunque le superan en número, Yugi nunca se rendirá, ¡mientras crea en el corazón de las cartas!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: El Maestro de los Mago: Parte 3
programme.desc: Para contrarrestar al Mago Oscuro de Arkana, Yugi saca un conejo de su chistera: ¡La Maga Oscura! ¡Es la batalla de los sexos para determinar quién es el verdadero maestro de los magos!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: El tramposo Larva Subterráneo teje una red de mentiras para atraer a Joey a un duelo desigual. Larva Subterránea infecta en secreto el mazo de Joey con un parásito que le impide invocar monstruos fuertes.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Joey aplasta al Gran Moth Definitivo Perfecto, pero Larva suelta a la feroz Reina de los Insectos, la joya de la corona de los insectos que aumenta su fuerza con cada oruga que canibaliza. ¿Conseguirá la reina devoradora de Larva someter a Joey?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi se enfrenta a otro de los nefastos Cazadores de Rarezas de Marik: ¡el silencioso pero mortal Cuerdas! Cuerdas bloquea todos los ataques de Yugi con Gelatina Reanimada, un limo resbaladizo que resucita cada vez que lo destruyen.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Cuerdas convoca a una de las criaturas más poderosas de la historia de Duelo de Monstruos... ¡el dios egipcio Slifer el Dragón del Cielo! ¿Qué posibilidades tiene la banda de monstruos mortales de Yugi contra un dios egipcio?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: El hechizo Cartas Infinitas permite a Cuerdas tener un número ilimitado de cartas en su mazo, ¡así que Slifer el Dragón del Cielo de Cuerdas puede crecer hasta un poder de ataque infinito!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Joey se enfrenta al duelista del mar Mako Tsunami y su grupo de bestias submarinas. Si Joey gana, tendrá las seis cartas de localización necesarias para entrar en las finales de Ciudad de las Batallas, pero si pierde, ¡tendrá que despedirse dels finales!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: ¡El guerrero marino de Mako, el Pescador Legendario, desata una ola de destrucción que va destruyendo a los monstruos de Joey! ¡Joey tiene que recurrir a sus habilidades, su entrenamiento y su experiencia antes de que todo se acabe!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: Doble duelo. Parte 1: Yugi y Kaiba contra Lumis and Umbra
programme.desc: ¡Los secuestros abundan! Marik, con la ayuda de Bakura, secuestra a Joey y Téa. Además, los Cazadores de Rarezas también secuestran a Mokuba para obligar a Yugi y Kaiba a enfrentarse a los duelistas Umbra y Lumis en lo alto de un rascacielos.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: Doble duelo. Parte 2: Yugi y Kaiba contra Lumis and Umbra
programme.desc: Lumis y Umbra destruyen sistemáticamente el caótico trabajo en equipo de Yugi y Kaiba. ¿Podrán Yugi y Kaiba aprender a dejar de lado sus diferencias antes de ser enviados a un viaje sin retorno al Reino de las Sombras?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: Doble duelo. Parte 3: Yugi y Kaiba contra Lumis and Umbra
programme.desc: Yugi y Kaiba empiezan a mostrar signos de trabajo en equipo, pero es demasiado poco y demasiado tarde cuando Umbra y Lumis convocan a la Bestia Enmascarada Des Gardius, ¡una monstruosa amenaza aún más poderosa que el Dragón Blanco de Ojos Azules!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: Doble duelo. Parte 4: Yugi y Kaiba contra Lumis and Umbra
programme.desc: ¡Yugi combina sus monstruos magnéticos en la potencia polar de Valkyrion el Guerrero Magno! Sin embargo, poco sabe Yugi que Umbra y Lumis tienen una última máscara para volver a los monstruos de Yugi contra él.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi y Kaiba van en misión de rescate para salvar a sus amigos. Pero en el camino, todas sus preocupaciones y secretos se revelan al revivir los problemas que han enfrentado... ¡y que enfrentarán en el futuro!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: El duelo es de amigo contra amigo porque Marik controla mentalmente a Joey para que se bata en duelo contra Yugi. El perdedor será arrastrado al océano. ¿Podrá Yugi liberar a Joey de su hechizo, o será Joey el que acabe con Yugi?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Aunque Joey le ha diezmado sus puntos de vida, Yugi no se atreve a atacar a su querido amigo. Yugi convoca al monstruo favorito de Joey, el Dragón B. de Ojos Rojos, para intentar que Joey recupere la cordura.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi empieza a romper el hechizo de Marik sobre Joey, pero ahora debe batirse en duelo sin el Rompecabezas del Milenio. Cuando Joey roba la carta que necesita para diezmar los puntos de vida de Yugi, ¿qué posibilidades le quedan para ganar?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Solo queda un minuto de duelo para que el perdedor caiga en las profundidades del mar. ¿Se enviarán estos mejores amigos a su perdición? Sin embargo, puede haber una salvadora especial que acaba de recuperar la vista.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Es la batalla de los espectros porque Bakura desata su ejército de fantasmas contra los feroces zombis de Bonz para poder entrar en la final de la Ciudad de la Batalla. Pero, ¿por quién doblará la campana final cuando jueguen en el Reino de las Sombras?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Es un juego de amor porque el rompecorazones de Hollywood, Jean-Claude Magnum, desafía a Mai a un duelo para conseguir su mano. ¿Sucumbirá Mai al encanto de Jean-Claude, por no hablar de su grupo de monstruos ninja?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: ¡Que comience la final de la Ciudad de la Batalla! Los ocho finalistas pondrán a prueba su habilidad y resistencia en una arena de duelo a miles de metros de altura.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: El espíritu oscuro se revela: Yugi contra Bakura: Parte 1
programme.desc: Es el primer duelo de la final. Yugi se enfrenta al espíritu maligno del Anillo del Milenio que posee a Bakura. Yugi se deshace de los grotescos espectros de Bakura, pero él tiene una estrategia sacada directamente del cementerio…

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: El espíritu oscuro se revela: Yugi contra Bakura: Parte 2
programme.desc: Bakura activa el Tablero del Destino, que hará que Yugi pierda automáticamente en cinco turnos. Por si fuera poco, el Santuario Oscuro de Bakura daña los puntos de vida de Yugi cada vez que ataca! Sin poder atacar y sin tiempo, Yugi está atrapado.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: El espíritu oscuro se revela: Yugi contra Bakura: Parte 3
programme.desc: Slifer el Dragón del Cielo de Yugi está a punto de dar el golpe final para ganar el duelo, pero Bakura podría no sobrevivir a la explosión del todopoderoso monstruo egipcio.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: La furia de los dioses egipcios
programme.desc: ¡Por fin se revela el origen de las cartas de dioses egipcios! El misterioso Shadi lleva a Yugi a un viaje a través del tiempo hasta la creación de Duelo de Monstruos... ¡y los peligrosos poderes que liberó!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: En el segundo duelo de la final, Odion, disfrazado de Marik, desconcierta a Joey con numerosas trampas para llevar el duelo a un punto muerto. Sin embargo, Joey cuenta con la Tornado Gigante, la contrapartida perfecta que garantiza la victoria de Joey.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Las Encarnaciones de Apophis de Odion se ensañan con los monstruos de Joey... ¡y con sus puntos de vida! ¿Podrá Joey utilizar eficazmente los monstruos que ganó antes en el torneo, o está ya demasiado nervioso para montar un contraataque exitoso?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Es un frenesí devorador porque el Serket de Odion devora a los monstruos de Joey para transformarse en poderosas etapas de evolución. ¿Cómo puede Joey derrotar a Serket cuando éste ingiere los monstruos de Joey cada vez que los invoca en el campo?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Odion utiliza una carta de dios egipcio falsa para invocar al tercer monstruo divino egipcio, el Dragón Alado de Ra, y lo utiliza para aniquilar los cinco puntos de vida que le quedan a Joey.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: Un juego mental: Mai contra Marik: Parte 1
programme.desc: El tercer duelo de la final de la Ciudad de Batalla entre Mai y Marik no es un duelo normal. Es una batalla en el temido Reino de las Sombras donde perder puntos de vida equivale a perder tus recuerdos.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: Un juego mental: Mai contra Marik: Parte 2
programme.desc: A medida que Mai pierde cada vez más recuerdos bajo el implacable asalto de Marik, también pierde la confianza en sus habilidades para combatir en duelos.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: Un juego mental: Mai contra Marik: Parte 3
programme.desc: Mai se hace con el control del Dragón Alado de Ra de Marik, pero es incapaz de averiguar cómo desatar sus poderosas habilidades.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: Un duelo con el destino: Kaiba contra Ishizu: Parte 1
programme.desc: En el cuarto duelo de la final de la Ciudad de Batalla, la misteriosa oponente de Kaiba es... ¡Ishizu! Con el poder de su Collar del Milenio, Ishizu puede ver el futuro. ¡Incluso todas las cartas que Kaiba tiene previsto jugar!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: Un duelo con el destino: Kaiba contra Ishizu: Parte 2
programme.desc: Utilizando la magia de su Collar del Milenio, Ishizu ya ha visto el resultado del duelo: ¡derrotará a Kaiba con su trampa! ¿Cómo puede ganar Kaiba si ya está destinado a perder? Es hora de que Kaiba cambie el futuro.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: El secreto de los guardianes de tumbas
programme.desc: A medida que crece la maldad de Marik, Ishizu revela los secretos de su linaje: ¿Cómo pasó Marik de niño bondadoso a tirano ávido de poder que quiere dominar el mundo? ¿Podrá Yugi salvar a Marik del borde de las tinieblas, o ya es demasiado tarde?
